exposure: volume of cervical varices (aVCV) quantified by MRI
cohort: The study included 98 individuals with singleton pregnancies and placenta previa who underwent prenatal MRI and cesarean section at a tertiary care center in Japan between April 2012 and March 2021.
finding: Large cervical varices (aVCV >36.0 cm3) are an independent predictor of massive blood loss in placenta previa, particularly in cases of posterior previa without placenta accreta spectrum.
gest_age: MRI performed around 34 weeks of gestation
